snippet.title: Rebus Master: Picture Puzzles — Read the Picture, Crack the Rebus! | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Read the picture. Crack the rebus. 🧩

Rebus Master is a picture puzzle game with 1,700+ illustrated rebus levels — English words, phrases and idioms hidden in funny drawings. Spot the pieces (S + PRESS + O = ESPRESSO!), type the answer and enjoy the "aha!" moment.

▶ Play free:
Android (Google Play): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.favogames.rebus
iPhone (App Store): https://apps.apple.com/app/id6765225349
Free daily rebus in your browser: https://rebusmaster.com/daily

What's inside:
• 1,700+ illustrated rebus levels — idioms, phrases and words
• Lock twists — locked letters, double locks and chained words
• NEW: Survival Rush — beat the clock! Every solve adds time, a wrong letter costs 3 seconds
• Make it yours — avatars, frames, pawns and charms, including the Riddle King set
• Collect seasonal cards, team up in weekly Team Battles, climb the rankings and challenge friends to duels

Every level is playable without paying; purchases are optional.

Music: original score composed for this trailer.

#RebusMaster #RebusPuzzle #PicturePuzzle #WordGame #PuzzleGame #BrainTeaser #Idioms
